title: Outpatient psychiatric evaluation
description: An outpatient psychiatric evaluation is a comprehensive assessment where a psychiatrist or mental health professional evaluates your mental and emotional health. During this visit, your doctor will ask about your medical history, current symptoms, family history of mental health conditions, and any medications you're taking. They may discuss your mood, sleep patterns, stress levels, and how your symptoms affect daily life. This evaluation helps your doctor diagnose mental health conditions and develop a treatment plan tailored to your needs, which might include therapy, medication, or both.
